decision: A shipping-container prop viewed from all sides. The reference has a closed rectangular silhouette with corrugated dark side walls, gray double doors, gold locking rods, corner castings and hazard markings. The 290,949-triangle TRELLIS source is too dense for one Roblox mesh. The earlier 9,000-triangle reduction retained the box silhouette but damaged the crisp ribs and doors and darkened the finish. Author clean geometry with recreated surface detail, one material atlas and a bottom pivot. Use a provisional 22-stud nominal length and non-colliding decoration role pending user visual approval.
